registration: Frozen before new checkpoint training or test prediction; no changes to previous KeyCLD results.

dataset.selection: Freeze every fully accepted assembly available at preparation; retain all registered test assemblies and all three conditions. No selection by model results.
dataset.split: Preserve assembly-level train/test split. Within the original 12 validation assemblies per planar category, ordinals 97-102 are calibration only; 103-108 are model validation only.
dataset.sampling_unit: Independent assembly; conditions paired, video views not independent samples
dataset.generation: Use existing accepted videos and physics only; collection remains paused.

input_contract.controller: After t=1s the command is constant. Recompute torque from the model's own predicted crank velocity using the declared servo law; never replay ground-truth future feedback torque.
input_contract.camera: Fixed world rectangle, orthographic Y=0 rectification. Existing source camera framing used whole-trajectory bounds; this version is explicitly a recorded-camera/calibration-given track, not a future-blind camera protocol.

training.checkpoint: Final epoch 40 only; save optimizer/RNG state for exact resume
training.main_method: Unchanged official encoder, renderer, point mass, potential, input matrix, constraints solver and reconstruction + dynamics + BCE loss; Euler, 4 steps, original augmentation and Adam grouping with retained optimizer state.
training.diagnostics: State arms receive true point coordinates and velocity, train only dynamics; paired initialization/seeds/data/updates. RK4 has four substeps per video interval.
training.scope: Joint multi-assembly training across the three supported planar families. New 30Hz images, geometry per assembly, calibrated controller wrapper, force action semantics and expanded data/update count are explicit adaptations, not an exact replication of the original paper's data distribution.

evaluation.derivative_track: Native ODE at 240Hz, separately audited; not a generic video-reader ranking
evaluation.physical_reader: Declared B/C/midpoint semantics; one keypoint permutation selected on model-validation assemblies only; report its held-out semantic error and geometry coverage
evaluation.limit_basis: Same engineering precision as the earlier planar diagnostic profile; force 5% of the 5Nm actuator limit, energy 1% of 5Nm times 1rad. New independent calibration must pass before reporting scores.
controls: raw simulator states with independent rigid-body equations
evaluation.aggregation: Six equal-weight pass-rate components and all-six joint pass rate. Macro average by mechanism family then condition. Missing metrics retain denominator and coverage.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired hierarchical bootstrap over training seed and independent assembly, keeping conditions paired; 2000 draws, seed 20261012
evaluation.parameter_claims: Report SI force-balance, energy and response; fixed per-family friction and confounded speed/load do not independently establish friction or mass identification. No kg claim for latent point masses.

unsupported.S-C: Gear transmission needs a validated gear-coordinate/keypoint adaptation; not silently treated as a three-link chain.
unsupported.S-E: Unilateral cam contact and event work need a contact-capable adaptation.
unsupported.H-A: Official KeyCLD uses two-dimensional latent points; Stewart requires validated 3D orientation/constraint and observation interfaces.
unsupported.H-B: Official KeyCLD uses two-dimensional latent points; Delta requires validated 3D rigid-body interfaces.
